about: Camera spots for the walkable gate scene, in the section frame (metres: X east = out of the city, D north, H height; facing_deg 0 = +X, 90 = north). Everything placed in the world (structures, the road, trees, figures) comes from the scroll map through layout.json (tools/map_layout.mjs); this file only says where the camera can stand.

bridge.about: on the moat bridge looking into the city (the spawn)

street.about: inside the city looking out through the gate

tower.about: beside the watchman on the tower balcony, looking down the road to the bridge

crowd_note: The gate section holds roughly 60 people by the research notes' figure groups (a rough count, not an inventory).
